== Summary ==
Players Committee promotional banner for the [[2026 World Championship]] ("Minnesota Worlds 2026 – Bloomington, MN – October 23–25, 2026"): a loon with raised wings over the Minneapolis skyline and the SWCCG Players Committee badge.

* '''Source:''' lead image of [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-upcoming-october-23-25-in-minneapolis-mn/ 2026 World Championship – Upcoming October 23–25 in Minneapolis MN], starwarsccg.org (2 October 2026); also shared in the Players Committee Slack #announcements the same day.
